en: Changed the dangerous `rm` prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode to wait 2 minutes for an answer, then deny the command with a rewrite hint so unattended sessions keep going (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1` turns this off)
zh: 变更 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 和自动模式下危险的 `rm` 提示，改为等待 2 分钟以获得回答，然后拒绝该命令并给出改写提示，使无人值守的 session 得以继续（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT=1` 可关闭此行为）
